reviews.x: I really like the hair, however I didn't get 8 packs/96 strands as the description says, I only received 4 packs.  I contacted the seller and was told that they were put in 4 packages, each pack include 2 bundles, and each bundle is 12 roots.  I pulled each bundle out and counted the strands, because it really didn't look like it was a total of 96 strands.  once I counted all, I found that I was short 18 strands because there was only 78 strands total. reviews.t: A great buy for a  protective style.
reviews.x: I ordered the spring twist and it came overnight. The hair is beautiful.  I also received  hair clips and a chrochet needle. I received  4 bags with 24 pieces  in each bag.The color was 1b . I will use it as a protective  style. I love the look and texture  of the hair and I will  purchase this hair again

reviews.t: Order 2 packs for whole head, unless you have a small head
reviews.x: Love the hair!! Received it the day it was promised to be delivered, came with cute colorful rubber bands, a few cute hair jewels and the crochet hook. Maybe should have ordered another pack because I had to rearrange a few for full head application.Very pleased, will definitely order again!

I like the hair and it turned out really nice. Definitely get compliments on it. There is a "way to install" the hair without untangling it or getting big knots at the base due to the coils... once you get it down the install goes fairly quickly. I bought 2 bags n used a couple of pieces of the 2nd pack. The 2nd pack did have a different "smell" to it though. Other than that, overall I like the product.

One of the most important things I would like to say that I love about the hair and the company that I ordered it from is that; it made it super easy for me to pick out my color, and pick out my style.  I received more than enough hair for the price that I paid. Now moving on to the texture of the hair. I must say that it was soft, light weight and has an elegance to it that I look for when doing my own personal style.  I will be eagerly waiting to make another order from them to do more persona

I was looking for a long term style before I get my birthday  preparations popping. Crochets, was best to go to leave my hair alone. At first I was alil skeptical cause I read reviews, though it wouldn't be enough  or long to my liking. I'm a stylist so you know I cant be walking around looking crazy which I have a couple  of times. Baby my hair arrive on time it was well package; they gave me  the Crochet needle, colorful rubberbands and colorful hair jewels along with my hair. The twist  was n

At first glance the hair seems to be soft and light weight. It arrived fast even with the COVID-19 epidemic. The only con so far is the smell. It’s not horrible, I just prefer for my hair to have no scent. I love that there is a crochet needle and jewels with the package.
This hair is exceptional i will be purchasing more for sure, its so springy u can stretch it and it bounces back no friziness, soft to touch and very light on the head.

I like that it was easy to use this crochet hair for the twists I did manually around the perimeter. It's soft and springy. I love how polished and consistent the twists look. As a hairstylist, I prefer not to do a whole head of passion twists manually as the natural hair tends to stick out over time. Would recommend to my clients.

Ordered today and received the hair today... The hair is very soft and neatly twisted. There are no Crazy smells but as always advised, I will still co wash the hair to remove anything unseen impurities. I received 4 packs with 2 bundles of 12 in each that equaled to 96 strands as stated. So far very pleased with the hair...

[[VIDEOID:74930a77845204a63b33e7f32a04a76]] I’m so glad I got this hair! It’s super cute, stylish, soft and makes me look good 🤪  however ladies, if you notice that little strands of hair are sticking out or getting a little knotted, just pull them! It won’t harm or damage the hair at all ❤️

I love this hair. Can't wait to put it in my hair. Will give you guys an update! Exactly what I am looking for! Update...installed it, and this is my second time I have it in my hair and I am going to continue putting it cuz it's really a good hair. Got lots and lots of compliments

If you want a good product for a value, this the hair to purchase. I was so surprised at the amount of hair for the price. I bought the 10 pack, it was more than enough for my entire head. The twist are a nice size and easy to work with. I will definitely purchase again.

reviews.t: Very good and just the amount I needed
reviews.x: I first noticed that the strains were smaller than the others I am used to thought it was going to look bad but to my surprise it wasn't it was perfect not heavy either worth the money yes I added red another brand but the 1b is nice and full 😊 I paid 25.00 though

This hair is all that it says it to be!  Super soft and light weight!  I was hesitant at first in ordering, I am so glad I went with my first instinct and ordered this product.  I have gotten so many compliments.  I will be ordering again in the future!!

reviews.t: Nice hair and pretty easy to maintain/install
reviews.x: Can do individual twists or install as normal crochet (in cornrows). It’s easier and less time consuming to use this with cornrows. With individual, allow more time for separating hair and putting into braid. Installed Individual twists in 6 hours.

I have absolutely no complaints about this hair. There are no snags when looping the hair through. It’s lightweight and easy to maintain. It did have a light scent to it but other than that I will be purchasing this hair again

Super soft hair. I gave myself passion twists without cornrows (found a vid on YouTube) and these twists were super effective for that because they were easy to unravel to a certain length and then re-twist around my hair!

reviews.t: Only 12 strains of hair in each pack
reviews.x: The hair is beautiful & soft however it’s only 12 strains of hair in each pack i thought it was supposed to be 24 in each & i received 9 packs instead of 10 this will not be enough to complete a full look for my hair smh

I recieved my hair today, it's really pretty, exactly as described 4 packs of 24. Fast shipping. Only thing was the odd smell it has, but I'm sure with a little wash that should go away. Otherwise I'm very pleased

I sent an email upset because I thought it was only 4 bundles not realizing it's actually 12 in each pack. I was looking for 8 bundles of 12..duh...sorry! The hair is perfect! The 8 bundles was more than enough!

reviews.t: Best crochet hair I’ve ever used!
reviews.x: Omg this is the best braiding crochet hair I’ve ever used! Very light weight and the braids are so neat! No frizz, they have a very unique pattern in each and every braid. I will definitely be ordering again.

reviews.t: Great value, Great quantity, Just buy it!!
reviews.x: Product is semi soft. Very easy to install. Very light weight. I used all 10 bundles and it filled my head. I would suggest this product for the price and the quantity. The quality is also fair for the price.

These spring twists are perfect. Eight packs was more than enough for a nice full look. Most importantly, these are easy to grip with the crochet latch hook making styling super easy and fast. Very nice!
Great quality but I don’t think the hair is long enough to be the inches described in the caption..but it will do for the next 2 weeks.. if you’re looking for something long try the next stop.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the hair as soft, lightweight, and natural-looking.
Many customers say the hair is a good value and that they received plenty of hair for the price.
Several reviewers mention receiving helpful extras like a crochet needle, hair clips, rubber bands, and jewels with their order.
Some customers report confusion or disappointment about the amount of hair received versus what the description stated.
A few reviewers note a smell or scent with the hair, though it is generally described as not horrible.
